intro.quote: Kutannoon dhaabbata keenyaa ogeeyyii of-ilaalan dhaala aadaa kabajanii hawaasa isaanii amanamummaadhaan tajaajiluuf dandeettii xiinxalaa argatan guddisuudha.

two.caption: Ilaalcha Addunyaa & Hundee Hawaasaa

honor.title: “Amanamummaa, Wal-kabajuu fi Dhugaa Sammuu”
honor.body: Barataan Abyssinia Academy hundi beekumsa amalaan wal-qabate irratti of-kennu—yaada of-dandaʼe, ilaalcha adda addaa kabajuu, fi itti gaafatamummaa dhuunfaa kutaa hunda keessatti.
points: Hojii barnootaa dhugaa fi isaa mataa isaa taʼuuf kutannoo
honor.note: Aadaa wal-amantaa fi amala ijaaruu garee hunda keessatti.

leadership.title: Hoogganummaa Barattootaa & Itti Gaafatamummaa Waloo
leadership.body: Carraaleen hoogganummaa barattoonni hiriyoota isaanii tajaajilan, jireenya kampasii deeggaran, fi kunuunsa mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaaf taʼu shaakalan afeeru.

stewardship.title: Tajaajila Hawaasaa & Kunuunsa

items.title: Saayinsii Uumamaa & STEM
items.body: Fiiziksii, keemistirii, baayoolojii fi saayinsii naannoo shaakala laaboraatoorii fi rakkoo gaaffiin hogganamuun furuu waliin.
items.aside: Shaakala laaboraatoorii fi qorannoo saayinsii marsaa sadarkaa lammaffaa guutuu keessatti.

items.title: Herrega & Qorannoo Kompiitaraa

hero.title: Waaʼee Abyssinia Academy
hero.subtitle: Dhaabbata Sadarkaa Lammaffaa ({{grades}})
hero.tagline: Finfinnee keessatti cimaa sammuu, dhaala aadaa, fi hoogganummaa amalaa guddifna.
hero.paragraph1: Abyssinia Academy dhaabbata sadarkaa lammaffaa Itoophiyaa of-dandaʼe ({{grades}}) amantaa beekumsi sadarkaa olʼaanaa amala fi itti gaafatamummaa biyyaalessaa irraa addaan hin baasamne irratti hundaaʼee ti. Finfinnee keessatti argamuun, Akademiin barnoota ulfaataa saayinsii uumamaa fi herrega cimaa ogbarruu, seenaa fi amala lammummaa keessatti qorannoo namummaa waliin walitti fidu ittiin ogeeyyii qopheessa.
hero.paragraph2: Gabaabbiiwwan barnootaa fi sammuu cufaa duuba hordofuu ni didna. Ogeeyyiin keenya of-eeggannoodhaan dubbisuu, xumura karaa sirnaawaadhaan morkachuu, ilaalcha Amaariffaa fi Ingiliffaan ibsuu, fi dhaala seenaa biyya keenyaa kabajuu, yeroo qophii barnoota yuunivarsiitiif godhaman baratu.

matrix.title: Gabaabbii Akademii

hero.imageCaption: Ogeeyyii Abyssinia Academy keessatti jireenya barnootaa sadarkaa lammaffaa isaanii keessatti seminaarota saayinsii fi namummaa irratti hirmaatan.

story.title: Seenaa Keenya & Dhaala Barnootaa
story.paragraph1: Hundeeffamni Abyssinia Academy amantaa barsiisota Itoophiyaa walii-galuu irraa burqe: Finfinneen dhaabbata sadarkaa lammaffaa kutannoo qabu, bilchaata sammuu fi amala dargaggootaa Kutaa 9 hanga 12tti jiranii guddisu akka barbaachisu.
story.paragraph2: Akademiin barnoota ijoo sadarkaa lammaffaa, iddoowwan qoʼannoo sirnaawoo, shaakala laaboraatoorii fi naannoo gorsa barsiisaa gara barataatti xiyyeeffannoodhaan guutame irratti xiyyeeffata.

milestones.title: Hundeeffama Caasaa Sadarkaa Lammaffaa
milestones.body: Banamni marsaa sadarkaa lammaffaa waggaa afur dargaggoota Finfinnee guutuu tajaajiluuf qophaaʼe, galmee barnootaa, itti gaafatamummaa lammummaa fi beekumsa qophiif xiyyeeffannaa kennu.

milestones.note: Caasaalee idilee Ministeera Barnootaa waliin wal-simatan
milestones.title: Barnoota & Sadarkaalee Barnootaa
milestones.body: Walitti makamni caasaalee sadarkaa lammaffaa biyyoolessaa herrega, saayinsii fiiziksii fi uumamaa keessatti, barnoota afaan lamaan Ingiliffaa fi Amaariffaa waliin.

milestones.title: Kutaalee fi Wantoota Qoʼannoo
milestones.body: Guddina kutaalee sadarkaa lammaffaa, iddoowwan qoʼannoo, fi bakkeewwan barumsa saayinsii gaaffii waloo fi qoʼannoo olʼaanaa xiyyeeffannoon qabuuf qophaaʼan.

milestones.note: Balʼina garee Waajjirri Galmee ni mirkaneessa
milestones.title: Barnoota Sadarkaa Lammaffaa & Qophii Yuunivarsiitii
milestones.body: Qophii itti fufiinsa qabu garee sadarkaa lammaffaa sadarkaalee qormaata biyyoolessaa fi sirna qophii barnoota olaanaa jalatti.

story.archiveNote: Yaadannoo: Kuusaan seenaa fi galmeewwan bulchiinsaa Waajjira Hojii Akademii keessatti eegamanii gaaffii irratti ni argamu.

mission.label: Ergama
mission.title: Ijaarsa Barnootaa Cimaa Gaaffiin Hogganamu
mission.body: “Barnoota sadarkaa lammaffaa cimaa gaaffiin hogganamu ifummaa xiinxalaa, amala, fi kunuunsa aadaa guddisu kennuu; barattoonni hawaasa Itoophiyaa fi addunyaa balʼaatiif gumaacha gaʼaa akka gumaachan isaan qopheessuu.”

vision.body: “Dhaabbata sadarkaa lammaffaa Itoophiyaa fakkeenya taʼee dhaabbachuu, aadaa fi beekumsi fuulduraa ilaalu itti wal-argan, ogeeyyii of-ilaalan gaarummaa, of-gadi-qabuu fi kaayyoo sammuu qabatanii hogganan eebbisuu.”

apply.title: How to Apply
apply.body: Your application will require certified copies of academic records and guidance from the admissions office.
apply.step1: Obtain an application form from the school administration
apply.step4: Enroll and begin your academic journey

howToApply.p1: Admissions are open for {{grades}}. We review every applicant carefully — academic records, character, and readiness to join our learning community — rather than using a single formula.
howToApply.p2: Share your details through the inquiry form below. Our Admissions Office will guide you through assessment dates, required documents, and enrollment steps.

faqLeft.question: What does submitting an inquiry mean, and what's next?
faqLeft.answer: An inquiry tells our office you are interested. We will contact you with the next steps for assessment, documentation, and enrollment for Grades 9–12.

faqLeft.question: I missed a reply deadline. Can I still continue?
faqLeft.answer: Contact the Admissions Office as soon as possible. Late replies are reviewed case by case when capacity remains.

faqLeft.question: Can I appeal or reapply?
faqLeft.answer: Yes. You may request guidance on appeals or reapplication windows from Admissions after a decision is issued.

faqRight.question: My status is unqualified. What does that mean?
faqRight.answer: It usually means required criteria or documents were not met for this cycle. Admissions can explain options for the next intake.

faqRight.question: If my status is qualified, am I accepted?
faqRight.answer: Qualified means you meet academic criteria. Final acceptance depends on placement capacity, interview (if required), and completed enrollment steps.

faqRight.question: I submitted documents late. What should I do?
faqRight.answer: Email or visit Admissions with your reference details. We will confirm whether your file can be restored or resubmitted.

process.title: Start Online Inquiry
process.body: Complete the admissions interest form with student and guardian contact details.

process.title: Submit The Form
process.body: Send your inquiry so our office can open a file and reply with next steps.

process.title: Review The Submission
process.body: Admissions reviews your details and confirms assessment or visit guidance.

process.title: Gather Necessary Documents
process.body: Prepare academic records, identification, and any required certificates.

process.title: Interviewing Process
process.body: Attend placement assessment or interview when invited by the school.

process.title: Last Decision
process.body: Receive the admissions decision and complete enrollment to begin the term.
